description: chinamaxM Claude worker-contract hooks (ADR 0005/0007). SubagentStart injects the numbered Worker contract (complete-final-report duty) into a spawned chinamaxM Worker; PreToolUse(Agent) injects the verbatim no-attribution Relay rule into the dispatching parent. Matching is anchored and Registry-derived in Python — SubagentStart carries NO static matcher because Overlay Profiles are dynamic. Both fail open (exit 0, no injection) on any internal fault. Entries are additive; hosts-04 appends its SessionStart entry to this same file.
